mapper.select: select a.*,u.nick_name author_name,u.avatar author_avatar from article_info a, user_info u where article_id = #{articleId} and a.user_id = u.user_id

SELECT a.article_id as articleId, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as nickName, u.avatar, a.view_count as viewCount, a.like_count as likeCount, a.collect_count as collectCount, a.comment_count as commentCount, a.publish_time as publishTime, a.tags, a.is_original as isOriginal FROM article_info a LEFT JOIN user_info u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.status = 1
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY
a.view_count DESC
a.like_count DESC
a.publish_time DESC

SELECT a.article_id as articleId, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as nickName, u.avatar, a.view_count as viewCount, a.like_count as likeCount, a.collect_count as collectCount, a.comment_count as commentCount, a.publish_time as publishTime, a.tags, a.is_original as isOriginal FROM article_info a LEFT JOIN user_info u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_action ua ON a.article_id = ua.article_id AND ua.user_id = #{userId} WHERE ua.action_type = #{type} ORDER BY
a.view_count DESC
a.like_count DESC
a.collect_count DESC
a.publish_time DESC
SELECT share_count FROM article_info WHERE article_id = #{articleId}

SELECT a.article_id AS articleId, a.title, a.cover_image AS coverImage, a.summary, a.view_count AS viewCount, a.like_count AS likeCount, a.collect_count AS collectCount, a.publish_time AS publishTime, u.nick_name AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM article_info a JOIN user_info u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY (a.like_count * 2 + a.collect_count * 3 + a.view_count) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
